description: Simultaneous free-variable substitution in formulas replaces free variables by terms without placeholders and leaves scoped placeholders unchanged.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.subst.{u, v, u', v'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'} {β : Type v'} {n : ℕ}
  (φ : L.BoundedFormula α n) (f : α → L.Term β) : L.BoundedFormula β n
